selection: Annotation-only cross-speaker overlap components excluded as barriers. Greedy disjoint complete-reference runs, 10–29.84s, >=2 speakers. Four uniformly spaced plans per training meeting, six per validation meeting. Natural padding<=80ms capped at annotation midpoint. Original source first microphone bytes only.
inference: Existing native Qwen1.7B BF16 greedy512 unchanged, one resident model, explicit corpus language, no references/counts/activity input. No separation, denoising, gain, resampling or stitching.
limitations: Annotation-assisted scene diagnostic, not final whole-recording acceptance.
AMI word times are forced-aligned estimates; boundaries and overlap absence have annotation uncertainty.
Chinese sources already used by prior diagnostic separator experiments, not a new blind holdout.
Original room acoustics retained; no added noise does not mean acoustically clean.
Speaker return is scored with a fixed meeting-level mapping, never optimal per-clip relabelling.

resourceLimits.scope: This worker and its descendants only; no global or other-app changes.

correctedReferenceCoverage: All official AMI metadata speakers, matching complete set of word XML files. EN2001a A-E; r1 A-D selection retained as invalid, not used for Stage-A conclusions.
reuseRule: 26 byte-identical Chinese/ES2003b inputs, unchanged language/model/runtime binding; only six EN2001a replacements inferred.
